description: Create a new list in a space or folder. Requires name + space_id/space_name or folder_id/folder_name.

due_date.description: Due date (Unix timestamp ms or natural language).

due_date_time.description: Whether the due date includes a time component.

folder_id.description: Folder ID. For creating a list inside a folder.

markdown_content.description: List description in markdown. Use instead of content for formatted text.

space_id.description: Space ID. For creating a folderless list.

status.description: List color/status (e.g. 'red'). Refers to the List color, not task statuses.

team_id.description: The ClickUp Team ID or Workspace Name to use. If provided, the server will switch to this workspace for this and subsequent requests in the current session.

name: create_list
